import ast,json,sqlite3,contextlib

from types import SimpleNamespace as N

def fn(file,name,env):
 t=ast.parse((B/file).read_text());t.body=[n for n in t.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name==name]

 t.body.insert(0,ast.ImportFrom(module='__future__',names=[ast.alias(name='annotations')],level=0));ast.fix_missing_locations(t);exec(compile(t,str(B/file),'exec'),env);return env[name]
class Pg:
 def __enter__(self):return self
 def __exit__(self,*a):pass
 def cursor(self,**kw):return self
 def execute(self,q,args=None):self.q=q;self.used=False
 def fetchone(self):return {'count':2}
 def fetchmany(self,n):
  if self.used:return []
  self.used=True;return [{'id':'A'},{'id':'B'}]
 def fetchall(self):
  if 'Select "assetId", type, path' in self.q:return [{'assetId':'A','type':'thumbnail','path':'thumbs/A.jpg'}]
  return []
fetch=fn('src--db--psql.py','fetchAssets',dict(chk=lambda:True,mkConn=Pg,getSchema=lambda:N(asset='asset',assetFile='asset_file',assetExif='asset_exif',hasEncVidPath=True),Q=lambda q:q,dict_row=object(),ks=N(db=N(thumbnail='thumbnail',preview='preview')),rtm=N(pth=N(normalize=lambda p:p)),lg=log,mkErr=lambda msg,e=None:RuntimeError(msg)))

@contextlib.contextmanager

nfy=N(error=lambda *a:None,info=lambda *a:None);sto=N(nfy=nfy,now=None,cnt=N(),isCancelled=lambda:cancel_calls.append(True) or True)

out={'active_remote_assets':['A','B'],'thumbnail_filtered_fetch_ids':[a['id'] for a in remote],'local_ids_after_sync':[row[0] for row in c.execute('SELECT id FROM assets')],'deleted_vector_ids':vec_deleted,'cancel_checker_calls':len(cancel_calls),'message':msg};assert out['local_ids_after_sync']==['A'] and vec_deleted==[2] and not cancel_calls;c.close()

findings: Confirmed composed behavior: original fetchAssets sees active remote A,B but excludes B lacking thumbnail; original onFetchAssets computes local IDs minus filtered remote IDs and deletes B local row/vector despite B still active remotely. Own SQLite row removed and mock vector deletion recorded; no user file/server deletion.
onFetchAssets never calls sto.isCancelled; control cancellation checker deliberately true but called0 times. Remote fetching, local save and deletion sync can continue after manager marks cancelled.

onFetchAssets returns ordinary success-shaped tuple for DB connection/fetch failure or no assets; TskMgr treats tuple return as completed. UI error notification does not set failed task status. Source integration observation.

Fetch button disabled when remote count<=local count; equal-count changed metadata or replacement/deleted assets cannot be refreshed through normal enabled fetch action despite UI recommending re-fetch for changes. Source behavior, not UI rendered.

Sync deletion commits SQLite before vector deletion, catches vector-delete failure only in log yet retains success text. No transactional agreement between stores. Source finding; failure injection not included this control.

fetchAssets accumulates all active rows, all file metadata and EXIF maps before return; fetchmany batching does not bound total collection memory. Queries are not in explicit repeatable-read snapshot, so count/assets/files can represent changing DB state.

Asset-file entries keyed only by type overwrite previous rows with no edited-version selection or ORDER BY; thumbnail/preview choice can depend on DB row order. LivePhoto CID match similarly chooses final returned row without uniqueness/order requirement.

Schema detection caches globally, chooses legacy names when neither candidate found, fallback getSchema assumes defaults; init returns False on DB failure and read db.init does not check boolean return. Runtime connection alone not schema validation.
Safe timestamp loaders replace invalid/out-of-range years with 2000-01-01, potentially making unrelated unknown dates equal for metadata grouping. Source policy, not actual psycopg driver executed.
fetchExInfos creates default metadata objects even for nonexistent IDs; getUsrName cache refreshed only if user count changes, so renamed users with same count remain stale. Source findings.

Vector UI says CLIP but reviewed imgs.py uses ResNet152. Reconcile claims all orphans but only scans missing-uuid points before generation; UUID-bearing stale/orphan points remain outside this specific cleanup step.

vec_ToVec excludes every this-round requested asset from post-repair, not only successfully saved IDs; waitForGreen timeout leads warning and final success. vec_Clear does not clear old similarity relations/status, so stale simInfos may prevent future getAnyNonSim searches after regeneration. Source observations, integrated runtime unexecuted.
